prev_agent:
Here's what the block-yield pattern would look like for the Recent Sites section:

```erb
<%= render Dashboard::DataTableComponent.new(rows: @sites) do |table| %>
  <% table.with_column(key: :name, label: "Name") %>
  <% table.with_column(key: :subdomain, label: "Subdomain") %>
  <% table.with_column(key: :status, label: "Status") do |row| %>
    <% if row.production_theme_version_id.present? %>
      <%= render Ui::BadgeComponent.new(variant: :success, dot: true) do %>Published<% end %>
    <% else %>
      <%= render Ui::BadgeComponent.new(variant: :warning, dot: true) do %>Draft<% end %>
    <% end %>
  <% end %>
  <% table.with_column(key: :indexing, label: "Indexing") do |row| %>
    <%= render Ui::BadgeComponent.new(variant: row.allow_indexing? ? :success : :danger, dot: true) do %>
      <%= row.allow_indexing? ? "Allowed" : "Blocked" %>
    <% end %>
  <% end %>
  <% table.with_column(key: :created_at, label: "Created") %>
<% end %>
```

The key difference: columns with a block (`do |row|`) get custom rendering, while columns without (`key: :name`) fall back to simple value display.
